concepts.gloss_en: The simple/absolute Unity (of God); divine oneness underlying the varied works of creation
The revealing/manifestation of the simple Unity (an event/predication about the Unity, not the Unity itself)

members.note: contains verb נתגלה — a clause asserting the Unity is revealed; per rule 4 an action/state about X is not X. Keep separate from the bare concept.

notes: Both occur in lm2:2 and share the referent 'the simple Unity,' but one is the concept and the other embeds it in a predicate about its revelation. Under-merge preferred.
